verdict.rationale: The Solo 2 firmware source is public in the solokeys/solo2 GitHub repo. That repo and the official getting-started guide document compiling and flashing it with cargo, and a community member confirms it is "open source firmware." However, no evidence item names the license or quotes a license file, so the open-license part rests only on community characterization. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or SPDX identifier) cited from first-party sources, and evidence that the hardware design is open (the community notes it is not)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
